body:
Please make sure to test it with classic theme.
"PanelContainerTabbarInner" in classic theme is completely transparent, if I remember correctly.
Good reminder, and yeah looks like it is: Still looks a tiny bit more organized compared to master IMO, but wonder if there should be some kind of style in the classic theme?

Also please take into account https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14445#issuecomment-4058227641 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14445#issuecomment-4058285432.
If there is no similar style (I do not know if there are any similar ones), you can create a new one that will look the same in all themes.

I did read that, and think the default "Pause" icon looks better and still makes sense even though it isn't a full "pause".

But I do agree with Ivorforce, I can mess with it or if anyone wants to create a new logo, that would be cool! :)
~Just added support for the "PanelContainerTabbarInner" in the classic theme~ Added "PanelContainerButtonGroup", with a slightly less border radius in the classic theme. **Dark:** **Light:**
`Allow game input as usual.`
`Disable game input and allow selecting Node2Ds, Controls, and manipulating the 2D camera.`
`Disable game input and allow selecting Node3Ds and manipulating the 3D camera.`
I updated to a new icon provided by PiCode9560 in https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14445.
Made this text very contextual. Feels kinda' good ;)
Marked as resolved but not actually applied. Was it discussed somewhere else?

This one I left out as the surrounding texts still refer to it as "Game Embedding", and it felt like a solo change.

I can update it if wanted tho.
